metadata.ImageDescription:
Pictures From Iran
British troops attacked the island of Aradian on the River Shatt-el-Arab, at the head of the Persian Gulf, in order to gain control of a large oil refinery, belonging to the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company. Indian troops were landed from assault ships from the quayside and they attacked the Iranian strong points in the refinery. This image shows a view of the Indian riflemen seen at various points in the refinery on guard.

metadata.ImageDescription: This is my Dad (on the far right front row), with the rest of the General Engineering Firm, and the flight crew, stood in front of the Vulcan just before she left for the Falklands, where she would ultimately bomb Port Stanley.

wikitext:
== {{int:filedesc}} ==
Taken in 1982, at [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/RAF_Waddington RAF Waddington] stood in front of the [[Avro Vulcan]] ￼[https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avro_Vulcan] just before it left for the [[Falklands War|Falklands war]] [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falklands_War]

The members of the General Engineering Firm, and the flight crew. 

The Vulcan went on to bomb [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanley,_Falkland_Islands Port Stanley] during the war. 

Later in the 1980s my Dad went to help rebuild Port Stanley. {{Information
|description=This is my Dad (on the far right front row), with the rest of the General Engineering Firm, and the flight crew, stood in front of the Vulcan just before she left for the Falklands, where she would ultimately bomb Port Stanley.
